name: Azure Container Registry Lifecycle
description: Azure Container Registry stores the images your clusters run. Creating a registry the attacker owns, or deleting yours, is a supply and availability problem: they can host images, or they can take yours away. Seeing create or delete in the activity log does not by itself prove they pushed a backdoored image. It proves someone changed the place images live. Treat unexpected registry create/delete as impact until image-push logs say otherwise.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
